name: @holosystem/bravura
description: Bravura — teaching a person to conduct, in VR. Beat, phase, and the physics of a following ensemble.

scripts.canary: node build.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{const f='dist/main.js';const s=fs.statSync(f);if(!s.size)throw new Error('build produced an empty bundle');console.log('canary ok:',f,s.size,'bytes')})"

$note: The canary checks the BUILD ARTIFACT exists and is non-empty, not that the build command exited 0. The standing failure in this ecosystem is a route that reports success and does nothing — 'exit 0' is not evidence, a file on disk is.
